verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only anti-blocking building blocks: proxy IP rotation and a SessionPool that rotates proxies along with cookies. Nothing documents Apify itself solving CAPTCHAs, completing logins, or getting past form walls on an agent's behalf. These are adjacent controls and developer primitives, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically get past a CAPTCHA, login, or form wall without my manual intervention

citations.quote: Avoid blocking by smartly rotating datacenter and residential IP addresses.
SessionPool is a class that allows you to handle the rotation of proxy IP addresses along with cookies and other custom settings in Apify SDK.
